annotations.title: Cancel a running or scheduled campaign

description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Cancel a running or scheduled campaign

Stops a submitted campaign: pending calls are abandoned and the campaign moves to `cancelled`. Calls already placed are not undone and remain chargeable, so cancelling limits further spend rather than reversing it. A campaign that was never submitted is refused with 400 and should be deleted instead, and one that is already `completed`, `cancelled` or `failed` is refused with 409. Cancellation is recorded locally even when the upstream stop could not be attempted. This operation uses the `write:agents` scope rather than a scope of its own.

campaignId.description: Identifier of the campaign to cancel.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
